title: Rav Huna bar Minyomi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.39a.14-15): he bought tekhelet from members of Rav Amram Chasida’s household and came before Rav Yosef (to ask whether he could trust them); he did not have [the answer]. Chanan the tailor met him and answered his question.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=973&lang=en) give the purchase from Rav Amram Chasida’s household, the inquiry before Rav Yosef, and the reply by Chanan the tailor.
